data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 樱花树下的命名纪念
data.description: 盛开的樱花树下，她仰头看着花瓣飘落，轻声念着自己的名字；「十香」这个被赋予的名字，是她与这个世界最初的契约。
data.action: 盛开的樱花树下，她仰头看着花瓣飘落，轻声念着自己的名字
data.promptProse: Beneath the flowering cherry tree, Tohka raises her face to drifting petals and touches the ribbon above her half ponytail. Her lips quietly shape her own name in a private anniversary moment, violet eyes open with wonder. The medium view keeps her school uniform against the trunk and overlapping blossoms. Afternoon light filters between branches, brightening her eyes and the near petals while the tree side of her collar stays shaded.
